Step:  
09-13-1753 minus 67 days.  
September 13 → back 13 days = August 31 (13 days in September).  
Remaining 67 - 13 = 54 days to subtract.  
August has 31 days, July has 31 days.  
August 31 minus 31 days = July 31.  
Remaining 54 - 31 = 23 days.  
July 31 minus 23 days = July 8.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1753-07-08
